diagnosis: The generator encoded category-level masses instead of the specific source construction.
Distinctive LEGO assemblies were reduced to generic rectangles, circles and wedges.
The test therefore measured recognition of abstract vehicle classes rather than recognition of roster assets.
attempts.consequence: Reject every V1 sheet. Do not continue to the 44- or 72-cell V1 review and do not count the V1 confusion audit as game-director evidence.
Approve the source-derived silhouette method for expansion to a new complete 66-asset corpus. This does not accept the complete roster or close T082.

systemicDiagnosis: Several source-derived units are recognizable but contain incorrect detachable-module, weapon, cockpit, landing-contact or vehicle-proportion decisions.
Many adapted buildings communicate only a generic support-building category and sometimes the wrong faction.
The weakest new-content silhouettes do not communicate whether they fly, walk, deploy or operate as fixed structures.
Do not proceed to the 44- or 72-cell review until the 24-cell failures are revised.
attempts.consequence: Keep T082 on HOLD. Preserve the strong candidates, revise the failed or ambiguous silhouettes, apply the resolved exclusively-airborne ETX Alien Strike canon correction, then rerun the 24-cell blind review before testing wider camera distances.

activePilot.rule: The source-derived method may now expand to a second complete-roster corpus. T082 still requires the complete 24/44/72-cell blind review and explicit game-director corpus acceptance.

activeFullV2.rule: Revise the failed and ambiguous 24-cell silhouettes before continuing to the 44- and 72-cell review.
